provenance.powerPointAutomation: used once, deliberately, by a maintainer: scripts/animation_catalog/powerpoint.applescript was run on 2026-10-31 from a terminal holding the Automation grant - the sdpm dashboard itself still cannot, because addressing PowerPoint from it is refused with a -10004 privilege violation - and its output is checked in under provenance.scriptingOracle.fixture. An entry whose verification is 'scriptingOracleCapture' carries the OOXML PowerPoint wrote for it; every other value still comes from the offline scripting definition, captured native OOXML, and normative schema. sdpm's runtime, CLI, MCP servers, tests and CI never pass the oracle's consent argument, so nothing here launches PowerPoint on its own (REQ-7.3), and VBA is not used at all.

scriptingOracle.driver: AppleScript scripting dictionary; no Visual Basic
scriptingOracle.unprobedReason: the run aborted in msoAnimDirectionConstants before these probes, so this capture says nothing about them; their entries carry no capture block
scriptingOracle.animationHalf: every MsoAnimEffect candidate was refused with “main sequence of timeline of slide N of presentation “Presentation1” doesn’t understand the “add effect” message”, and no slide in the package carries p:timing. add effect is declared in PowerPoint.sdef but PowerPoint for Mac 16.113.1 does not implement it on main sequence, so no animation value can be captured through the dictionary at all; the GUI procedure in scripts/animation_catalog/computer-use.md is the only animation-side route
scriptingOracle.legacyShapeEntryEffects: the refused EPPEntryEffect candidates are the 0x00f60d** per-shape entry-effect band plus the 'unset' sentinel. A refusal there confirms the catalog's outOfScope classification rather than recording a gap
scriptingOracle.transitionDurationEvidence: every captured transition carries the same spd and p14:dur, because the probe set the slide's entry effect and nothing else: the value is the transition duration the script-created probe slide already held, not the effect's own default. One effect default is known from two other measurements that disagree with it - the Box tile's native capture and the Transitions ribbon both read 1600 ms - so defaultDurationMs keeps its native-capture value and this capture is recorded as the probe-context duration only

behaviorPayloads.evidence: ECMA-376 Part 1 PresentationML animation behaviours (CT_TLSetBehavior, CT_TLAnimateEffectBehavior, CT_TLCommandBehavior, CT_TLCommonBehaviorData) and the animation attribute-name vocabulary

behaviorTiming.note: CT_TLCommonBehaviorData always carries a p:cTn, so the visibility change is a one-millisecond discrete state change held by fill=hold rather than a duration-less node. An entrance shows the shape at the effect start (delay 0); an exit hides it exitDelayOffsetMs from the end of the active duration, so the outgoing filter stays visible for the whole effect and the state change finishes exactly with it.

p:set.note: an entrance makes the shape visible and an exit hides it; the emphasis p:set children (Underline, Bold Reveal, Brush Color) set a font attribute whose name is not captured, so those tiles are refused

p:animEffect.filter: the captured animEffectFilter string of the same catalog entry
p:animEffect.note: ST_TLAnimateEffectTransition is normative; the filter strings come from the native captures, and an entry without one is refused

p:cmd.note: only media Play is captured (cmd playFrom(0.0)); ST_TLCommandType is the allowlist the writer validates an explicit behaviors list against

unresolved.p:anim: the animated attribute name and value formula of a gallery preset are not captured
unresolved.p:animMotion: preset motion-path geometry (p:animMotion/@path) is not captured
unresolved.p:animScale: the preset scale factors are not captured
unresolved.p:animRot: the preset rotation angle is not captured
unresolved.p:animClr: the preset target colour is not captured

behaviorPayloads.childOrder: the capture reports a tile's behavior children as a set, not in document order, so the writer emits them in the recorded order. Visibility is governed by the p:set start condition above, not by the node's position among its siblings.
behaviorPayloads.writerRule: generate a preset only when every behavior child it records appears under resolved. A preset with any unresolved child raises BehaviorPayloadGapError naming each one; the writer never emits a behavior node whose payload it had to omit. An explicit JSON behaviors list supplies exact values and is written verbatim after its enumerated attributes are validated against the ECMA-376 allowlists.

capabilityLevels.nativeTemplate: exact OOXML captured from retail PowerPoint for this value

capabilityLevels.semanticPreservationOnly: JSON round-trip only; the OOXML identifier or geometry is not established here and the writer must capture it or emit a documented fallback

ooxml.note: a custom effect is modelled as an explicit behaviours list rather than a preset

p:subTnLst/p:animClr[@clrSpc='rgb'][@dir='cw'] animating ppt_c, with p:cBhvr/@override='childStyle' and p:cTn dur='1' fill='hold' display='0' masterRel='nextClick' afterEffect='1'. The colour is p:to/a:schemeClr for a scheme swatch and p:to/a:srgbClr for an explicit colour; those are the only two things that differ between dim and dimColor. Measured: the Accent Scheme Color swatch writes accent2, not accent1, so the other seven swatch mappings are not inferred from labels.

measured 2026-11-02 through the pane's 'More Colors...' item, which opens a Colors window. The node is the same p:animClr the scheme swatches write; the only difference is the colour child, p:to/a:srgbClr instead of a:schemeClr. Corroborated: the Colors window's own colour well read rgb 0.752941 0.313725 0.301961, which is 192, 80, 77 -- exactly the C0504D that was written, so the value was read back rather than chosen

p:subTnLst/p:set animating style.visibility to 'hidden', with p:cBhvr/@override='childStyle' and p:cTn dur='1' fill='hold' display='0' masterRel='sameClick' afterEffect='1'. Only this value carries a start condition: p:stCondLst/p:cond[@evt='end'][@delay='0']/p:tn/@val names the effect's OWN p:cTn id, because hiding after animation has to wait for that effect to end.

p:subTnLst/p:set animating style.visibility to 'hidden', identical to the hide form except masterRel='nextClick' and no p:stCondLst — the hide waits for the audience rather than for the effect. masterRel is the single attribute separating the two.
no markup at all: clearing the pane's After animation to Don't Dim removes the whole p:subTnLst rather than leaving an empty one, so the default is an absence.
